senses.gloss: प्रध प्र-ध. See under प्र-धा, col. 3.

प्र-ध, अस्, आ, अम्, holding, having; (आ), f.,
see Scholiast on Pāṇ. VI. 4, 64; N. of a daughter
of Dakṣa.

प्रधा प्र-धा, cl. 3. P. A. -दधाति, -धत्ते,
-धातुम्, to place or set before, offer; to give up,
deliver.

प्राधा प्राधा, f., N. of a daughter of
Dakṣa and mother of several Apsarasas and Gan-
dharvas; [cf. प्र-धा.]

प्रधन प्र-धन, अम्, n. spoil taken in
battle, a prize gained by a victor; a contest, conflict,
combat, fight, war, battle [cf. धन]; tearing,
rending, destruction, destroying; (अस्), m., N. of a
[]
man; (आस्), m. pl., N. of his descendants.
—प्र-
धनोत्तम (˚न-उत्˚), अम्, n. ‘best of battles,’ a
great battle or contest.

प्र-धान, अस्, आ, अम्, chief, main, principal,
capital (city); pre-eminent, most eminent, most ex-
cellent, best; prevalent, predominant, preponderant,
principally or pre-eminently inherent; (अम्), n. a chief
or principal thing, chief object, the most important
thing, the head, chief, (often at the end of a comp.,
e. g. इन्द्र-प्रधान, having Indra as the chief
object; cf. धर्म-प्˚, विनय-प्˚, यथा-प्रधा-
नम्); (in Sāṅkhya phil.) = प्रकृति, ‘the Ori-
ginant,’ primary or original matter or rather the
primary germ out of which all material appearances
are evolved, the first evolver or source of the material
world (hence in a general acceptation ‘nature’ or
rather ‘matter’ as opposed to पुरुष or ‘spirit’);
the Supreme Spirit, the Supreme Deity; intellect, un-
derstanding; (in grammar) the principal member of a
compound (opposed to the उप-सर्जन or secondary
member by which the primary member is qualified);
(अस्, अम्), m. n. the first companion or attendant of
a king, his minister or counsellor, his eunuch or con-
fidant; a courtier, a noble; an elephant-driver; (अस्),
m., N. of an ancient king.
—प्रधान-कर्मन्,
अ, n. or प्रधान-कार्य, अम्, n. chief or principal
action; the principal mode of treatment (in medi-
cine).
—प्रधान-तम, अस्, आ, अम्, the most
excellent or distinguished, most important, chiefest.
—प्रधान-तर, अस्, आ, अम्, more excellent,
better.
—प्रधान-तस्, ind. according to eminence
or superiority.
—प्रधान-ता, f. pre-eminence,
excellence, superiority, supremacy, prevalence; the
being Pra-dhāna, q. v., (in Mahā-bh. Vana-p. 173
= जगत्-कारणता; cf. शरीर-प्˚.)
—प्रधान-
त्व, अम्, n. pre-eminence, superiority, excellence;
(in Sāṅkhya phil.) the being Pra-dhāna, q. v.
—प्रधान-धातु, उस्, m. the chief element or
ingredient of the body, semen virile.
—प्रधान-
पुरुष, अस्, m. a chief person, most distinguished
personage; an epithet of Śiva.
—प्रधान-पुरु-
षातीत (˚ष-अत्˚), अस्, m. transcending Pradhāna
and Puruṣa (matter and spirit); an epithet of Śiva.
—प्रधान-भाज्, क्, क्, क्, receiving the chief share,
presiding over; the most excellent or distinguished.
—प्रधान-मन्त्रिन्, ई, m. a prime minister.
—प्रधान-मित्र, अम्, n. a chief friend.
—प्र-
धान-वासस्, असी, n. du. two principal garments, best
clothes.
—प्रधान-वृष्टि, इस्, f. very copious rain,
heaviest rain.
—प्रधान-शिष्ट, अस्, आ, अम्, taught
or laid down as of primary importance; [cf. अन्वा-
चय-शिष्ट.]
—प्रधान-सेवा, f. chief or prin-
cipal service.
—प्रधानाङ्ग (˚न-अङ्˚), अम्, n. a
chief member, the chief member of the body; most
eminent person in a state; principal branch of a
science, &c.
—प्रधानात्मन् (˚न-आत्˚), आ, m. the
highest personal principle, the chief soul, an epithet
of Viṣṇu; one with crude nature or Viśva-bhāvana.
—प्रधानाध्यक्ष (˚न-अध्˚), अस्, m. a chief
superintendent.
—प्रधानाध्यक्ष-ता (˚न-
अध्˚), f. the office of chief superintendent.
—प्र-
धानामात्य (˚न-अम्˚), अस्, m. a prime minister.
—प्रधानोत्तम (˚न-उत्˚), अस्, आ, अम्, best of
the eminent, eminent, illustrious; warlike, brave.

प्रधन्य, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. forming or consti-
tuting the spoil or booty (as cattle).
प्रधान्य, a wrong reading for प्राधान्य, q. v.

प्राधान्य, अम्, n. predominance, preponder-
ance, prevalence, ascendancy, pre-eminence, superi-
ority, supremacy; the being the highest object; a
principal cause; प्राधान्येन or प्राधान्यात् or
प्राधान्य-तस्, ind. in regard to the highest object,
with reference to the chief purpose; in the highest
degree, chiefly, principally, especially.
—प्राधान्य-
स्तुति, इस्, इस्, इ, receiving especial praise, chiefly praised,
especially celebrated.

प्रधमन प्र-धमन. See under 1. प्र-
ध्मा, p. 632, col. 1.

प्र-धमन, अम्, n. blowing in, blowing into
(the nose, as powder &c.); a sternutatory.

प्रधर्ष प्र-धर्ष, &c. See under प्र-
धृष्, p. 632, col. 1.

प्र-धर्ष, अस्, m. attacking, assaulting, assail-
ing; [cf. दुष्-प्˚.]

प्रधानक, अम्, n. (in Sāṅkhya phil.) primary or
original matter (= प्र-धान, अ-व्यक्त, q. q. v. v.).

प्र-धि, इस्, m. that which is placed round the
nave of a wheel, the circumference or periphery of
a wheel; a well.
—प्रधि-मण्डल, अम्, n. the
circumference of a wheel.
प्रधि प्र-धि. See above.

प्रधी प्र-धी, ईस्, f. great intelligence; (ईस्, ईस्,
इ), of superior intelligence, pre-eminently intelligent.

प्रधाव् 1. प्र-धाव्, cl. 1. P. A. -धावति,
-ते, -धावितुम्, to run forwards, run forth, run away;
to set out, start; to become diffused, spread; to
pervade, permeate: Caus. P. -धावयति, -यितुम्,
to drive away, drive.

प्रधाव् 2. प्र-धाव्, cl. 1. P. A. -धावति,
-ते, -धावितुम्, to wash; to rub off: Caus. -धाव-
यति, -यितुम्, to cause to wash; to wash.

प्र-धावित, अस्, आ, अम्, run forwards, run away;
set out, started.

प्र-धावन, अम्, n. rubbing or washing off;
(अस्), m. air, wind (regarded as a ‘purifier,’ cf. प-
वन; or perhaps fr. 1. प्र-धाव्, regarded as a
‘runner’).

प्रधृ प्र-धृ, Caus. -धारयति, -यितुम्, to
direct towards, place or fix upon; (with मनस्)
to set the mind upon anything (dat.), resolve, deter-
mine; to bear in mind, keep in remembrance; to
reflect, consider; to chastise, punish, inflict a punish-
ment or penalty on any one (with loc.; cf. दण्डं
धृ).

प्र-धारण, अस्, ई, अम्, keeping, preserving,
protecting [cf. पाद-प्˚]; (आ), f. (probably) a parti-
cular high order of intelligence.

प्रधृष् प्र-धृष्, cl. 1. 5. P. -धर्षति,
-धृष्णोति, -धर्षितुम्, to be bold against, assail
with courage or daring; to lay hands on, hurt,
injure, harass; to overpower, overcome: Caus.
-धर्षयति, -यितुम्, to attack, assault, assail; to
hurt, injure; to overcome; to violate (a woman);
to destroy, lay waste, devastate.

प्र-धर्षक, अस्, इका, अम्, attacking, assailing;
molesting, troubling, harassing.

प्र-धर्षण, अस्, ई, अम्, attacking, assailing;
molesting, troubling, harassing; (अम्, आ), n. f. attack-
ing, assailing, an attack, assault; ill treatment, molesta-
tion; केश-प्रधर्षण, dragging by the hair.

प्र-धर्षणीय, अस्, आ, अम्, to be assailed or
attacked, assailable, open to attack, exposed to injury
or ill treatment.

प्र-धर्षित, अस्, आ, अम्, attacked, assailed;
hurt, injured; haughty, arrogant.
—प्रधर्षित-
वत्, आन्, अती, अत्, arrogant, proud.

प्र-धृष्ट, अस्, आ, अम्, treated with contumely;
proud, arrogant.

प्र-धृष्टि, इस्, f., Ved. overpowering, subju-
gation.

प्र-धृष्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be hurt or injured,
violable; [cf. दुष्-प्˚, सु-प्˚.]

प्रध्मा 1. प्र-ध्मा, cl. 1. P. -धमति,
-ध्मातुम्, to blow before or in front, blow forth,
blow away, destroy; to blow into (with acc.): Pass.
-ध्मायते, to be blown or tossed about, wander
about: Caus. P. A. -ध्मापयति, -ते, -यितुम्, to
blow into, blow (a conch shell).
2. प्र-ध्मा, आस्, आस्, अम्, blowing violently.

प्र-ध्मापन, अम्, n. (in medicine) a remedy
for assisting respiration in any obstruction of the
air-passages.

प्र-ध्मापित, अस्, आ, अम्, blown into, blown
(as a conch shell).

प्रध्यै प्र-ध्यै, cl. 1. P. A. -ध्यायति, -ते,
-ध्यातुम्, to meditate upon, reflect upon, think of
(with acc. or with प्रति); to reflect, consider; to
excogitate, devise, hit upon.

प्र-ध्यान, अम्, n. reflecting, reflection, think-
ing, thought; deep thought, subtile speculation.

प्रध्वंस् प्र-ध्वंस्, cl. 1. P. -ध्वंसति,
-ध्वंसितुम्, to fall to pieces, fall in ruins, be de-
stroyed, perish: Caus. -ध्वंसयति, -यितुम्, to
cause to fall, destroy, cause to perish; to scatter,
sprinkle (Ved.).

प्र-ध्वंस, अस्, m. utter destruction, annihila-
tion; loss.
—प्रध्वंस-त्व, अम्, n. a state of
destruction, ruin.
—प्रध्वंसाभाव (˚स-अभ्˚),
अस्, m. non-existence in consequence of annihilation,
ceasing to exist, complete extinction.

प्र-ध्वंसन, अस्, ई, अम्, destroying, annihi-
lating; (अस्), m., Ved. one who destroys or anni-
hilates, a destroyer.

प्राध्वंसन प्राध्वंसन, अस्, m. a patro-
nymic from Pra-dhvaṃsana.

प्र-ध्वंसिन्, ई, इनी, इ, passing, transitory, perish-
able; destroying, annihilating.

प्र-ध्वस्त, अस्, आ, अम्, fallen to pieces, disap-
peared, perished, destroyed, annihilated.

प्रध्वन् प्र-ध्वन्, cl. 1. P. -ध्वनति, -ध्व-
नितुम्, to sound forth, resound.
प्र-ध्वनयत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, causing to sound.

प्राधनिक प्राधनिक, अम्, n. (fr. प्र-
धन), an implement of war, a destructive weapon.

प्राधानिक प्राधानिक, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. प्र-
धान), pre-eminent, most eminent or distinguished,
best, most excellent, superior; predominant; derived
from or relating to Pradhāna or primary matter (in
the Sāṅkhya phil.).
प्राधेय, अस्, ई, अम्, descended from Prādhā.

प्राधीत प्राधीत, अस्, आ, अम्, (fr. rt. 5. इ with
प्र-अधि), well-read, highly educated, learned (said
of Brāhmans).
प्राध्ययन, अम्, n. reciting, reading, studying.

प्राध्येषण प्राध्य्-एषण, अम्, n. (fr. rt. 3.
इष् with प्र-अधि), Ved. incitement, exhortation
(to study).

प्राध्व प्राध्व (प्र-अध्˚), अस्, आ, अम्, being
on a road or journey, distant, remote, long, a long
way off; bent, bowed, inclined; favourable, conform-
able; (अस्), m. a car, carriage; (अम्), ind. favourably,
conformably, agreeably; crookedly, in a contrary
way (?).
—प्राध्वं-कृ, cl. 8. P. A. -करोति, -कु-
रुते, -कर्तुम्, to make conformable, to bend conform-
ably, to join together (as the hands) in token of good-
will.
—प्राध्वं-कृत्य, ind. making conformable.

प्राध्वन (प्र-अध्˚), अस्, m., Ved. the bed of
a river or stream.

प्राध्वर प्राध्वर, अस्, ई, अम्, an epithet of
a branch of a tree; (probably an incorrect form.)
